lede: UTSA carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.6 against -9.1, a 12.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it UTSA -17.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with UTSA winning 88% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass defense, where UTSA leads Colorado State by 110 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 63% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
